'''High Profile Ward''' was a high-security ward of the [[Shadow Town]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It housed valuable prisoners of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], among whom was [[Watcher X]] until his escape in [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
High Profile Ward appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Imperial Agent class mission on Nar Shaddaa.
